'''Ayelixe Fabrico''' was a company that manufactured textiles and clothing.<ref name="Arms" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Unidentified textile transport|transport]] carrying Ayelixe textiles exploded in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]].<ref name="Fleeced">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Fleeced}}</ref> Ayelixe eventually merged with [[Krongbing Interstellar Fashions]], a larger but struggling clothing corporation, to form [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]].<ref name="Arms" />
